title_sq: Shitet dublex 4+1 Rezidenca White Tower, Komuna e Parisit.
description_sq:
Shitet dublex 4+1 Rezidenca White Tower, Komuna e Parisit.
Apartamenti disponon siperfaqe totale 229.3 m2, siperfaqe e katit te pare 105 m2, siperfaqe e katit te dyte 85.4m2 dhe siperfaqe e perbashket 38.2 m2.
Kati i pare organizohet ne sallon ndenje me ambient gatimi dhe ngrenie, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon.
Kati i dyte organizohet ne tre dhoma gjumi dhe dy tualete.
Cmimi i shitjes 530.000 €
title_en: Duplex 4+1 White Tower Residence for sale, Paris Commune.
description_en: Duplex 4+1 White Tower Residence for sale, Paris Commune. The apartment has a total area of ​​229.3 m2, first floor area 105 m2, second floor area 85.4 m2 and total area 38.2 m2. The first floor is organized into a living room with a kitchen and dining area, a bedroom, a bathroom and a balcony. The second floor is organized into three bedrooms and two bathrooms. Selling price €530,000
